description: Binary reward prompt for Gemini VLM. Sent with all three camera images (top, left, right). Returns YES if task is complete, NO otherwise.
template:
You are a binary reward function for a bimanual robot manipulation task.

## Task
{task}

## Instructions
You are given images from three cameras (top, left, right) observing the robot workspace.
Determine whether the robot has **successfully completed** the task described above based on the current visual evidence.

Respond with ONLY a single word:
- YES — if the task appears to be completed successfully
- NO  — if the task is not yet completed or has failed

Do not include any other text, explanation, or punctuation. Just YES or NO.
